vectors.intent_statement: Constrain BITS-CODEGEN to registered dispatch work and review-only delivery authority.
Define Sterling's public floor capabilities, subject allowlist, health contract, and fail-closed escalation.
Bound the Living-World Floor sprint to its authorized public TypeScript surface.
Attach governance provenance to deterministic TypeScript lint rules.
Enforce deterministic TypeScript lint rules across production and test code.
Keep generated dependencies, builds, coverage, and browser artifacts out of source control.
Define deterministic public-safe operating rules and bootstrap behavior for Finance Guild agents.
Attach governance provenance to the reproducible npm dependency graph.
Lock the verified Node, Datadog, NATS, TypeScript, lint, build, and test dependency graph.
Register the Finance Guild service and public operational surfaces in Datadog Service Catalog.
Verify exact Finance subjects, state-change suppression, telemetry, encoding, and fail-soft publishing.
Publish cleansed living-world state changes while degrading safely when NATS is unavailable.
Centralize the immutable public Finance Guild contract and prevent NATS subject drift.
Prove real-state projection, validation, champion binding, bounded quests, and quiet-floor expiry.
Maintain a deterministic public floor projection sourced only from observed guild operations.
Initialize Datadog tracing before service modules load with dispatch provenance tags.
Emit public-safe structured service logs without serializing private payloads.
Project the public Finance realm feed into a small-screen interface without inventing values.
Render an accessible mobile-first shell for the public Finance living-world feed.
Capture mobile web vitals only when deployment supplies an explicit public RUM configuration.
Prove public realm and party contracts, champion binding, mobile shell, and quiet fallback.
Expose fail-soft public realm, party, health, and mobile surfaces with no private fields.
Compose the public service so HTTP remains available when NATS or telemetry is absent.
Measure real floor heartbeats, quest throughput, and champion transitions without affecting availability.
Attach governance provenance to the strict TypeScript compiler configuration.
Compile the Finance service with strict Node and browser TypeScript checks.
Enforce focused tests and an eighty-percent coverage floor on living-world code.
Declare runnable build, lint, test, tracing, custom metrics, NATS, and browser RUM dependencies.
Repair the existing CML adapter so it reports only real handler output and typed failure state.
Repair the existing Finance listener with structured logs and fail-soft missing-source behavior.
Start the traced Finance HTTP service on its declared port with orderly shutdown.
Return a typed public health response aligned with Finance service identity.
Persist substantive file, relationship, and verification provenance for post-merge ingest.
Attach governance provenance and validation ownership to the dispatch memory payload.
